title: Oil Selloff Sets Up “The Sweet Spot for Gold” and Bitcoin | Robbert van Batenburg
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Oil Selloff Sets Up “The Sweet Spot for Gold” and Bitcoin | Robbert van Batenburg Oil is down almost 20% and gas is down 25% since the end of October, and Robbert van Batenburg, Global Strategist at The Bear Traps Report, says that sets up a dovish Fed and "the sweet spot for gold," which is good for Bitcoin too. This post Oil Selloff Sets Up “The Sweet Spot for Gold” and Bitcoin | Robbert van Batenburg first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
